summary_en: This note introduces the weighted power mean, states its monotonicity and limit properties, and then gives inequality examples motivated by HM-AM and AM-GM. It emphasizes how different means can be used to estimate sums and convert between additive and multiplicative structures.

problems.statement_en:
Definition: For nonnegative real numbers \(x_1,\dots,x_n\), positive real weights \(w_1,\dots,w_n\), and nonzero real \(p\), define
\[
M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n)=\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^n w_i x_i^p}{\sum_{i=1}^n w_i}\right)^{1/p}.
\]
In particular, if \(w_1=\cdots=w_n=1\), then
\[
M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^n x_i^p}{n}\right)^{1/p}.
\]
problems.statement_zh:
对于非负实数\(x_1,...,x_n\)，以及正实数\(w_1,...,w_n\),以及非零实数p:
\[
M_{p}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n};w_1 \cdots w_n)=\left({\frac {\sum _{i=1}^{n}w_{i}x_{i}^{p}}{\sum _{i=1}^{n}w_{i}}}\right)^{{1}/{p}}
\]
特别的，如果权重都为1，\(w_1 = w_2 =...=w_n = 1\)那么
\[
M_{p}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n})=\left({\frac {\sum _{i=1}^{n}x_{i}^{p}}{n}}\right)^{{1}/{p}}
\]

problems.statement_en:
Property 1 (order relation): Under the same weights, if \(p<q\), then
\[
M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n) \le M_q(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n).
\]
problems.statement_zh:
在相同的权重系数下，如果\(p<q\)那么:
\[
M_{p}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n};w_1 \cdots w_n) \leq  M_{q}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n};w_1 \cdots w_n)
\]

problems.statement_en:
Property 2 (limit properties):
1. \(\lim_{p\to +\infty} M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n)=\max\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}\).
2. \(\lim_{p\to -\infty} M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n)=\min\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}\).
3. \(\lim_{p\to 0} M_p(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n)=\prod_{i=1}^n x_i^{\frac{w_i}{\sum_{j=1}^n w_j}}=M_0(x_1,\dots,x_n; w_1\cdots w_n)\).
problems.statement_zh:
性质2：极限性质
1. \(\lim_{p \rightarrow +\infty} M_{p}(x_1,...,x_n;w_1 \cdots w_n) = \max\{x_1,...,x_n\}\)
2. \(\lim_{p \rightarrow -\infty} M_{p}(x_1,...,x_n;w_1 \cdots w_n) = \min\{x_1,...,x_n\}\)
3. \(\lim _{p\to 0}M_{p}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n};w_1 \cdots w_n)=\prod _{i=1}^{n}x_{i}^{\frac{w_{i}}{\sum _{j=1}^{n}w_{j}}}=M_{0}(x_{1},\dots ,x_{n};w_1 \cdots w_n)\)

problems.statement_en:
Assume \(x,y,z\) are positive real numbers. Prove that
\[
\frac{x}{y+z}+\frac{y}{x+z}+\frac{z}{x+y}\ge \frac{3}{2}.
\]
key_techniques: adding 1 to reveal common numerator structure

problems.statement_en:
For any real numbers \(a,b,c\), prove that
\[
(a+b+c)^2\ge 3(ab+bc+ac).
\]

key_techniques_discussed: limit transition from power means to max, min, and geometric mean
transforming reciprocal sums via harmonic mean
converting between additive and multiplicative structures
connections_mentioned: maximum and minimum as limiting means
